optimizedDescription.value: Indexes multi-workspace code/specs into one graph with collision-free identities, exact selector normalization, and package-aware resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules
- File/Document canonical ID `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`; project-global included resources outside workspaces use reserved `root:{projectRelativePath}`. Workspace ownership wins; never duplicate as `root:`.
- Persist `configRelativePath` from active `specd.yaml` directory, forward-slash, no leading `./`, permitting `..`; supports unprefixed selectors but never replaces canonical identity.
- Graph identity parser must recognize `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` and `^[A-Za-z]:$` as Windows drive paths, never workspaces. Workspace filter `C` cannot match drive path or `C:`. Applies to exclusions, hotspots, SQLite inclusion, package surfaces, CLI display.
- `SymbolNode.id = {filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}`; workspace enters through canonical file path.
- `SpecNode.workspace` stores configured workspace; spec IDs follow `{workspace}:{specPath}` with configured prefix.
- Discover each workspace from absolute `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.codeRoot`; `discoverFiles` returns root-relative paths and remains workspace-agnostic; indexer applies workspace prefix and config-relative path.
- Index specs directly through each `ProjectWorkspace` `SpecRepository`: `list()`, `persistedStateHash()`, artifact content from declared filenames (`spec.md` first, rest alphabetical; exclude metadata/locks), `metadata()`, `readPersistedDependsOn()`, `readPersistedImplementation()`. Missing metadata → title `specId`, empty description/dependencies. No CLI callbacks, heading parsing, or filesystem fallback.
- Pass 2 resolves relative imports inside workspace; packages through adapter-derived `packageName → workspaceName`; PHP qualified names globally. `SymbolIndex` contains every workspace before Pass 2.
- Resolution identity is structured workspace + module/package + public surface + symbol space, respecting language case/visibility and deterministic project config. Never global same-name inference. Workspace roots/package identities/project refs/autoload inputs affect derivation fingerprint.
- Exact file selectors normalize canonical workspace-relative, config/project-relative, and absolute paths to one file identity. Wildcards preserve pattern semantics and are never coerced to one file.
- `IndexOptions`: `projectRoot`, `workspaces: readonly ProjectWorkspace[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, optional progress/chunk/vcsRef, required `vcsRoot: string | null`. Removed `WorkspaceIndexTarget.specs` callback.
- `ProjectGraphConfig` supplies global include/exclude and per-workspace allowed/excluded paths plus `respectGitignore`; populated upstream from `SpecdConfig.graph`.
- `IndexResult.workspaces` reports each name with files discovered/indexed/skipped/removed and specs discovered/indexed.
- With `respectGitignore` true and non-null VCS-root from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`, load root and nested `.gitignore`; evaluate relative to each file; ignore exclusions cannot be re-included by `excludePaths`. Null VCS root skips root ignore and never probes `.git/.hg/.svn`. False loads no ignore files.

## Constraints
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
- Single `.specd/code-graph.lbug` per project.
- Indexer owns workspace prefixing/config-relative derivation; discovery stays workspace-agnostic.
- Spec semantics exclusively through `SpecRepository`.
- File identity metadata changes make existing stores incompatible; full rebuild required.
